item.description: The _normalize_path_segments function has incorrect logic for handling path normalization, particularly with absolute paths and '..' segments. It fails to properly implement RFC 3986 path normalization rules.
item.contract: The function should correctly normalize path segments according to RFC 3986 section 5.2.4, properly handling '.' and '..' segments while preserving the semantics of absolute vs relative paths.
item.acceptance: Tests in test_normalize_path.py should pass, specifically tests with paths containing '..' and '.' segments like "path/../to", "../path/to", "path/./to", etc.

item.description: The URL._normalize_path method has incomplete implementation that doesn't properly handle path normalization with dots and segments.
item.contract: The method should normalize paths according to RFC 3986 rules, handling absolute paths correctly and properly resolving '.' and '..' segments.
item.acceptance: Tests in test_url.py related to path normalization like test_join_path_normalized should pass, particularly those involving path segments with dots and double-dots.

item.description: The URL._make_child method incorrectly handles path normalization for absolute paths when appending paths with dots and segments.
item.contract: The method should properly normalize paths when appending child paths, ensuring that '.' and '..' segments are correctly resolved according to RFC 3986.
item.acceptance: Tests in test_url.py related to join operations and path appending should pass.

item.description: Missing import for normalize_path function that tests expect to be available in yarl._path module.
item.contract: Add a normalize_path function to yarl._path module that wraps the internal _normalize_path_segments implementation.
item.acceptance: Importing normalize_path from yarl._path should work without errors and produce expected normalization results.

item.description: The host parsing logic in _split_netloc doesn't correctly handle IPv6 addresses and malformed hostnames, causing failures in host_port_subcomponent tests.
item.contract: The _split_netloc method should correctly parse IPv6 addresses enclosed in brackets and handle malformed hostnames appropriately.
item.acceptance: Tests in test_url.py related to host_port_subcomponent should pass, particularly those involving IPv6 addresses and edge cases.
